stages.label: Intake
stages.about: Resolve the base and head revisions and prepare the checkout.

stages.label: Repository index
stages.about: Index the base revision: history, SZZ links, per-test coverage map, retrieval index (cached by SHA).

stages.label: Input guard
stages.about: Size limits, secret scan and prompt-injection scan of the PR text and added code.

stages.label: Diff parsing
stages.about: Map changed lines to the functions, methods and classes they belong to.

stages.label: Impact agent
stages.about: Claim which tests, modules and APIs the change affects, from coverage, call paths and retrieval.

stages.label: Historian agent
stages.about: Link changed functions to past bug fixes (SZZ) and the issues and PRs that explain them.

stages.label: Signals agent
stages.about: Change metrics: size, diffusion, ownership, churn, complexity, defect history, change intent.

stages.label: Test selection
stages.about: Choose the tests to run: those covering the changed lines plus those named in impact claims.

stages.label: Verification
stages.about: Run the selected tests with per-test coverage, mutate the changed lines, and check every claim.

stages.label: Reconcile claims
stages.about: Count VERIFIED / REFUTED / UNVERIFIABLE claims; ask the Impact agent once more if over half were refuted.

stages.label: Impact retry
stages.about: Self-correction: the Impact agent revises refuted claims using the execution evidence.

stages.label: Risk model
stages.about: Turn the verified evidence into a calibrated defect probability.

stages.label: Policy
stages.about: PASS, CANARY or BLOCK from the risk and the thresholds; verified test failures always block.

stages.label: Output guard
stages.about: Recompute the decision independently and check that LLM text cannot have changed it.

stages.label: Rejected
stages.about: Input guard rejected the PR (secrets or oversize diff): BLOCK, nothing sent to an LLM.

stages.label: Canary rollout
stages.about: After merge: shift traffic 10→25→50→100% and roll back on the first SLO breach.
